title: Fifteen Lessons from the Surah of the Cave

meta.title: Fifteen Lessons from the Surah of the Cave

lines.text: Fifteen lessons from the Sūrah of the Cave.
Allāh says of the cave youths:
It is We who relate to you, [O Muhammad], their story in truth.

quran.ar: نَّحۡنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَیۡكَ نَبَأَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ إِنَّهُمۡ فِتۡیَةٌ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمۡ وَزِدۡنَـٰهُمۡ هُدࣰى

lines.text: A cave, two gardens, a journey, a wall.
